blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Light Rail Transit Line 1 (LRT-1) operator on Friday said that it will install additional ticketing booths and implement other measures at the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX) station to ease high passenger volume. Private operator Light Rail Manila Corporation (LRMC) said that it is “actively” installing new ticket counters for Single Journey Tickets (SJT) and Stored Value Cards (SVC) to address the long queues during peak hours. “Working hand in hand with its government grantors, the Light Rail Transit Authority (LRTA) and the Department of Transportation (DOTr), LRMC is executing comprehensive operational enhancements aimed at delivering […]... Keep on reading: LRT-1 operator to upgrade PITX station for better passenger flow
